"'''Dr. Black'''" was the codename for a scientist working in [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] lab on a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&ndash;[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] hybrid. Dr. Black was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the Sith&ndash;Jedi [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] turned mad and killed everyone in the lab.
